newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent firmer, NYMEX rises after API data.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent firmer, NYMEX rises after API data.

text.p: June Brent crude futures in Asia were firmer in late afternoon trading on Wednesday as NYMEX rose off the back of neutral to bullish API data.
June Brent on SIMEX was last traded at $18.15 per barrel, up eight cents from London, which rose 10 cents overnight to $18.07.
NYMEX June crude was last traded on ACCESS at $19.80, up 14 cents from New York's close on Tuesday.

Brokers said the American Petroleum Institute (API) data showed a crude draw of 1.9 million barrels, excluding the often-ignored PADD 5 west coast region. Nationally, stocks rose 1.02 million, when a 2.00 million rise had been expected.
The API data implied record demand for gasoline, although traders said the calculation was not always reliable, especially so early in the season.
And the critical U.S. Northeast was experiencing below average temperatures, underpinning heating oilamrket.
